plain_description.what: Has Kimi-K2.6 solve 569 questions to see whether it would be a better reference answer source for the judge than the current one.
plain_description.why: A better reference should make judge verdicts more accurate; this was a cheap qualifying test before paying for a full re-judge.
plain_description.information: A pass would justify a re-judge with Kimi as reference. Result: done. It failed the gate (70.5% vs 72.5% on discriminating questions) and was not promoted. But the comparison was not like-for-like (different prompt and token budget, a design error), so a rule was added that candidates must be solved the same way as the incumbent. A later like-for-like test also found Kimi unusable as reference. Later ruled history rather than evidence, because it ran on the older question pool.
